scenarios.name: Minimize the ribbon while the direct panel list is open

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the ribbon display control is set to toggle between the full ribbon and tabs only
the direct panel visibility list is open
Modify is checked and Primitives is unchecked
the user clicks the ribbon display control
only the ribbon tabs remain visible
the user clicks the 3D Model tab
the temporary 3D Model command area opens
the user opens the direct panel visibility list
Modify is still checked and Primitives is still unchecked
the user clicks the ribbon display control
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
